title: The future of energy services: time for a step change in using data to improve the customer experience
summary: While robotic process automation (RPA) can be used to automate many industry processes, how do utilities ensure they automate the right processes rather than just use “tech for tech’s sake”? Expert guidance can help utilities avoid the common mistake of automating a bad process instead of fixing any underlying problem first, and then optimizing the process by applying RPA.
